reentry.f2_main_message: trigger4: claim WP716 VPS media lab runtime scope
reentry.active_nonduplicate_f2_boundary: F2-WP-716 generation 1 / VPS media-lab target-environment component runtime

facts: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B officially lists German and Offline/Streaming support.
The official Qwen3-ASR model card states that streaming inference is currently available only with the vLLM backend.

The official streaming demo maintains explicit per-session streaming state and finalizes it at end-of-stream; source capability alone does not prove target long-session stability or no-history-copy behavior.
NVIDIA NeMo-Speech.cpp now provides an official lightweight native C++ local runtime for Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B.
The official model/runtime documentation describes Nemotron 3.5 as multilingual across 40+ language-locales and exposes VAD masking, endpointing and language-conditioned streaming controls.
The official GGUF path materially strengthens T7-ASR-008 as a portable local-runtime competitor, but it does not justify running ASR008 before ASR004 closes on the identical comparator.

research_delta.reason: Attempt 4 is still nonterminal and subject-frozen; changing or redispatching it would create promotion-staleness and destroy matched-comparator causality.
asr008_falsifier_refinement: Use the identical pinned German FLEURS/non-speech audio hashes used by ASR004.
Measure native NeMo-Speech.cpp GGUF path separately from any Python/NeMo path.
Record WER/CER, silence false activations, endpoint decisions, first-partial latency, finalization latency, real-time factor, peak RSS and sustained CPU/GPU use.
Run at least two semantically distinct turns in one persistent session and reject any history-copy contamination.
Keep VAD/endpointing policy explicit so a gating advantage is not misattributed to the acoustic model.
Do not promote streaming/local-runtime credit from capability metadata or source availability alone.

next_exact_action: Consume the first exact persisted run/receipt evidence for ASR004 attempt 4. If exact target execution succeeds, complete the already-defined identical-audio German/non-speech comparator against faster-whisper including the multi-turn no-history-copy and per-turn cost-growth falsifier. Only then execute T7-ASR-008 Nemotron 3.5 via the official native NeMo-Speech.cpp GGUF route on the same audio and gating policy.
